Body.Content:
The new Azure portal (portal.azure.com) is generally available today. The Azure portal provides large, global, scalable, and available cloud experiences on Azure, including:
  • 2.5 billion monthly requests
  • 22 million blades opened monthly
  • Fast growing marketplace with over 3500 offers
  • Support for 18 languages
  • Available in 20 geographies
  • More than 1800 blades across 75+ experiences
  • Improved startup performance 50% and resource blade performance 300% in the last six months
To read the full details, see Announcing Azure Portal general availability.
